鋼鐵、重電產業 
S1120023@tss-c.com.tw 
 股價評價基礎： 
AI、半導體帶動用電需求激增，士電已接獲客戶需求，重電 T4 廠產能將於
4Q27 量產 ，2H28 開始貢獻營收 ；2027~2028 進入表後儲能工程認列高峰 ，
預估 2026/2027/2028 稅後 淨利 YoY+29%/+33%/+15% ， 稅 後EPS 
8.10/10.80/12.46 元，給予強力買進評等，目標價 250 元(20x 2028 EPS)，
潛在漲幅 22%。

營運近況摘要： 
士電成立於 1955 年，為台灣老牌變壓器生產商，技術來自三菱重工的技轉，
1H26 產品組合：電力配電(變壓器、配電盤)72%、車輛零件 15%、自動化設
備(工具機)10%、其他 3%。內外銷比 65%：35%。客戶包含：Mitsubishi 
Electric/Mitsuba Electric/ Panasonic/ Hitachi ABB/ Siemens/泓德能源/起
而行/和泰車。目前三個廠區都在新竹：電裝廠、新豐廠及重電廠。

2026 年重電 T1+T2 廠產能利用率提升，T3 廠、表後儲能小幅貢獻 
預估 2026 年營收 415 億元(YoY+12%)，因變壓器需求殷切，重電 T1、T2
廠產能利用率提升至 90%，重電 T3 廠 2025/9 開始量產，Lead time 1~1.5
年，4Q26 開始認列營收，2027 年全面貢獻；且公司在手 500MW 表後儲能
(太陽能儲能)統包案也開始貢獻營收 ； 毛利率21%(YoY+0.2ppts)， 因產品組
合較同期相同； 業外則有 金融資產 公允價值、匯兌利益挹注，稅後淨利
YoY+29%，稅後 EPS 8.15 元。

2027~2028 年 T3、T4 廠產能提升，表後儲能進入認列高峰 
展望 2027~2028 年，重電內銷(佔重電 80%)：政府希望強韌電網計畫完工
期限從 2033 年提早至 2028 年，依 2027 年預算書依然維持 2033 年完工，
2026/2027/2028 資本支出 46/118/155 億元，維持成長態勢。重電外銷(佔
重電 20%)： 為了因應全球 AI、半導體等強勁用電需求，重電 T4 廠將於
2027/9 量產，預期2H28 開始貢獻營收，2029 年全面貢獻，T1+T2 年產能
10GVA(十億伏安)，T3 可貢獻產能 5GVA、T4 再貢獻 5GVA，T4 主要客戶
為日本、美國電力市場，並專注在 345KV 變壓器生產。國內表後儲能(太陽
能)：公司在手 500MW 表後儲能案，若假設 2026/2027/2028 完工比率
10%/40%/50%計算，預計貢獻 7.5/30/37.5 億元，

HDI concerns easing
New capacity and price hikes boosting earnings visibility for 2027-28
We are increasingly confident in Gold Circuit’s transition towards higher-layer-
count HDI boards, supported by meaningful investments in technology, talent, and
new capacity. The planned capacity ramp aligns well with the next-generation

ASIC schedules of two major CSP customers, while potential layer-count increase
from 26 layers for Trainium3 to 34 layers for Trainium4 should drive meaningful
content growth. Meanwhile, PCB price hikes and improving cost pass-through
should support a sequential GM recovery from 3Q26. We raise our 2027/28 EPS
forecasts by 1%/9% and lift our TP from NT$1,955 to NT$2,000 while reiterating
our High Conviction Outperform rating.
Less concerned about the HDI transition

While the market remains concerned about Gold Circuit’s HDI capabilities, we
believe the company has recruited experienced talent and invested meaningfully in
HDI technology to support future ASIC demand. The second Thailand plant and
new capacity at the first Suzhou plant are scheduled to contribute from 2H27,
followed by the second Suzhou plant in 1H28, with all three expansions primarily
dedicated to HDI production. Importantly, the capacity ramp should align well with

the next-generation ASIC schedules of two major CSP customers. We expect Gold
Circuit to maintain its leading position in AWS Trainium4 and benefit from
meaningful content growth, driven by an increase in PCB layer count from 26 layers
for Trainium3 to 34 layers for Trainium4.
Price hikes underway
For AI accelerator PCBs, we believe Gold Circuit should gradually pass rising CCL
costs through to customers. Our checks suggest that non-AI PCB products are

being quoted at 3-4x prior price levels, with lead-times extending to at least four
months at leading PCB vendors. This indicates a tightening industry supply-demand
environment and suggests that the GM weakness seen in 2Q26 should not persist
in the coming quarters. We forecast GM to improve sequentially to 36.7%/36.8%
in 3Q26/4Q26.
Earnings revisions and valuation
We keep 2026SP EPS largely unchanged but raise our 2027/28 forecasts by 1%/9%
to reflect higher production value contributed by the new plants and increasing HDI

content. Accordingly, we raise our TP from NT$1,955 to NT$2,000, still based on
30x 2H27-1H28SP PE, and reiterate our High Conviction Outperform rating.

### Page 5

HDI concerns easing Gold Circuit - HC O-PF
14 September 2026 5
Investment thesis
We expect Gold Circuit to benefit from the strong CCL/PCB material upgrade trend,
rising shipments of AI servers and continued spec upgrades in CPU servers, which
require higher PCB layer counts. The upgrade in networking towards 800G should
also lead to improving margins for the company.
Catalysts
1) Accelerating server shipments driven by US CSPs and enterprise customers; 2)

server content value growth; 3) a stronger-than-expected networking demand
recovery; 4) a notebook demand recovery.
Valuation details
We value all of our coverage in the PCB/CCL space on PE as it better reflects
margins and earnings outlooks, which we believe the market will mainly focus on.
We use a target PE multiple of 30x, in line with the downstream server sector
average after the recent rerating driven by AI. Given GCE's higher-than-peer
revenue exposure to cloud servers and switches, its leading market position, and

our expectation of robust AI/ASIC server shipments with computing server demand
to gradually recover, we think 30x PE is justified as server/PC ODM suppliers have
all rerated to the 15-30x range on the back of the booming AI demand. And as GCE
also generates a similar number of sales from server and AI, it will likely enjoy strong
growth (better content growth from server and switch) and better returns (less
competition) than assemblers in the mid-to-long term.

Investment risks
Downside risks: (1) order adjustment as a result of chip shortages or supply chain
disruption; (2) weaker-than-expected cloud/datacentre Capex demand; (3) slower
adoption or delayed launch of Intel’s Eagle Stream and AMD’s Genoa platforms; (4)
further raw material price hikes, and (5) more severe competition across the
industry.

➢ 2Q26 獲利符合預期 
強茂 2Q26 營收 39.56 億元，QoQ+15.62%，YoY+16.34%，毛利率
33.22%， 稅後淨利4.88 億元 ，QoQ+69.58%，YoY+93.85%，EPS 1.28
元，獲利大致符合預期。毛利率維持季增趨勢，但營業費用比預期高，
主因是客戶拉貨強勁，備貨及物流相關費用多及提列獎金所致。 
➢ 下半年營收、獲利逐季向上 
AI 伺服器、車用及小訊號產品訂單能見度佳，強茂 B/B ratio 值維持在
1.3~1.5 高檔位置，3Q26 新增部份產能，加上產品調漲，預期營收及毛
利率持續向上；4Q26 有機會切入另一家 CSP 供應鏈，年底增加封測產
能(小訊號為主)、越南 TOREX 預計在 1Q27 交割，整體而言營運動能無
虞。預估強茂 3Q26 營收 42.51 億元，QoQ+7.47%，YoY+30.02%，
毛利率 34.44%，稅後淨利 5.58 億元，QoQ+14.39%，YoY+84.08%，
EPS 1.46 元。 
➢ 歐美重心轉移、非紅供應鏈，台 IDM 廠有訂價權 
在 AI 需求強勁推動下，單機櫃功耗持續上升並導入高壓直流電架構，帶
動功率元件量價同步提升，應用於伺服器功率元件年複合成長率遠高於
產業平均，在產能吃緊情況下，歐美 IDM 廠將重心轉向利潤較佳的高
壓、SiC 以及低壓大電流的 DrMOS 核心市場，排擠中低壓功率元件產
能。同時，安世、揚傑等中資背景企業面臨去中化，伺服器、車用工控
等領域加速將訂單轉向台廠。 
➢ 預估強茂 2027 年 EPS 6.95 元，建議買進，目標價 208 元 
投研部預估強茂 2026 年營收 159.39 億元，YoY+21.73%，稅後淨利
19.21 億元，YoY+61.22%，EPS 5.03 元；預估 2027 年營收 183.38 億
元，YoY+15.05%，稅後淨利 26.57 億元，YoY+38.29%，EPS 6.95 元。
目前強茂 PE 24X ，2026 年最高本益比已超越 2017~2018 年、
2020~2022 年功率元件景氣循環 20X~30X 區間，AI 伺服器的應用有
助拉升功率元件產業及公司評價，給予強茂買進建議，目標價 208 元
(2027F PE 30X)。

價同步提升，應用於伺服器功率元件年複合成長率遠高於產業平均，在產能吃緊情況
下，歐美 IDM 廠將重心轉向利潤較佳的高壓、SiC 以及低壓大電流的 DrMOS 核心市
場，排擠中低壓功率元件產能。同時，安世、揚傑等中資背景企業面臨去中化，伺服
器、車用工控等領域加速將訂單轉向台廠。 
目前成熟製程與後段封裝產能極度吃緊，具備晶圓代工、晶片設計到封裝完整布局的 
強茂等 IDM 廠，憑藉產品線的廣度及垂直整合優勢，能確保供貨不中斷並免受外包
產能排擠 ， 更實質掌握了稀缺產能的訂價權 ， 在這一波由AI 架構升級與地緣政治雙軌
驅動的轉單潮中，將成為優先且最大受惠者。 
機櫃功率愈大，功率元件量價同步提升 
AI 應用佔強茂營收比重 11%，多數來自運算托盤(compute tray)上 Power MOSFET、
Schottky、TVS 或小訊號等功率產品，運算托盤上功率元件產值佔整機櫃超過一半，
主要核心在整合式供電模組(DrMOS)，DrMOS 技術門檻高，由歐美大廠主導，台廠
不易切入，但供電相數的增加，將同步提升對周邊功率元件的需求量。 
以 GB300 為例，單顆 GPU 功率 1.4kW，電壓 0.8V，核心負載輸出電流是 1,750A，
根據單顆高密度 DrMOS / SPS 晶片的最大承載電流(70A~130A)規格去設計供電相
數(Power Phase) ，每一相數都必須配置一套完整的硬體元件，當 GPU 功率提升至
2.3kW (Vera Rubin) ，GPU 功率增加 60%，供電相數及功率元件需求量亦將等幅放
大。 強茂功率元件已成功打入CSP 大廠 ， 未來將持續受惠運算托盤上功率元件量的提
升及質的改變(如 TVS 相對大電流，晶粒面積變大，單價提升)，產業成長趨勢明確。 
預估強茂 2027 年 EPS 6.95 元，建議買進，目標價 208 元 
投研部預估強茂 2026 年營收 159.39 億元，YoY+21.73%，稅後淨利 19.21 億元，
YoY+61.22%，EPS 5.03 元；預估 2027 年營收 183.38 億元，YoY+15.05%，稅後淨
利 26.57 億元，YoY+38.29%，EPS 6.95 元。目前強茂 PE 24X，2026 年最高本益比
已超越 2017~2018 年、2020~2022 年功率元件景氣循環 20X~30X 區間，AI 伺服
器的應用有助拉升功率元件產業及公司評價， 給予強茂買進 建議，目標價 208 元
(2027F PE 30X)。

2606 裕民航運 ( U-MING )

報告日期： 2026 / 09 / 10 研 究 員：林奕頎（ Yichi Lin ） 
壹、投 資 建 議 
一.預期  202 6 年 稅後 EPS + 8.22 元， YoY + 91%，創  18 年新高  
2024 年全年  BDI 平均  1,755  ； 2025 年全年  BDI 平均  1,681 。 
2026 年（截至 9 月 8 日）  BDI 平均  2,5 12： 
1Q / 2026 單季 BDI 平均  1,955； 2Q / 2026 單季 BDI 平均  2,751。 
3Q / 2026 單季（截至 9 月 8 日） BDI 平均  2,9 28。 
2026 年 9 月 8 日 單日  BDI 3,5 84。 運價 強勢，推升航商獲利 。 
二.美伊衝 突日益激烈 ，荷姆斯海峽封閉，油輪運價快速上漲  
裕民 船隊有  3 艘原油油輪  及 1 艘成品油輪 。  美伊 停戰 破局 ： 
原油油輪 運價指數：從 7 月 2 日 1,850 ，漲至 9 月 8 日 2,938 ，
累計漲幅  59%  ； 成品油輪 運價指數：從 7 月 7 日 995，漲至
9 月 8 日 1,702，累計漲幅  71%。 油輪運價 上漲，裕民將受惠。  
三.預期 4Q 是 2026 年單季獲利高峰 ， 稅後EPS + 2.41 元，YoY + 55%  
(1) 美伊衝突， 荷姆斯海峽 封閉 ，天然氣供給中斷 ； 4Q 取暖
旺季，各國 將被迫 以燃煤取代天然氣，推升海運燃煤需求 。 
(2) 聯合國預期 超級聖嬰現象至少將持續到 2027 年 2 月，極端
氣候橫行 ； 巴拿馬運河缺水 嚴峻，持續降低船舶通行量，
將壓抑海運供給 。  即使超級聖嬰解除；  依過去 5 年資料
（參閱圖 1）， 巴拿馬運河季節性乾季最低水位會落在 5 月。 
(3) 散裝航運以  4Q 為例行的季節性 旺季 。 
基於 (1) ~ (3) ，宏遠預期 4Q 將是裕民  2026 年單季獲利高峰。  
四.基於保守，估 2027 年 BDI 僅 2,490 ，裕民稅後 EPS + 7.10 元 
2026 年 9 月 8 日 單日  BDI 指數  3,5 84。 
宏遠 基於保守 原則，假設  三大利空在 2027 年落實 ： 
(1) 荷姆斯 海峽不再受阻 ，天然氣供給上升，壓抑煤炭需求 。 
(2) 超級 聖嬰解 除，巴拿馬運河不再缺水。  
(3) 全球散裝 船舶 下水量大增 。 
宏遠 估 2027 年 BDI 平均值僅  2,490； 裕民稅後 EPS + 7.10 元。 
若上述三項利空沒有落實，則必須調高裕民  2027 年獲利預估 。 
五.建議： 4Q 旺季  遇上  戰爭及聖嬰；  估 2026 年獲利，18 年新高  
2026 年截至 9 月 8 日，BDI 指數都 大幅 高於 2025 年同期（參閱
圖 2）； 此外，美伊戰爭造成 荷姆斯海峽中斷 ，須以燃煤取代
天然氣，推升散裝海運需求；  而 超級聖嬰 帶來全球乾旱，即
將撞上  巴拿馬運河  每年 12 月 ~ 隔年 5 月的 季節性 乾季（參
閱圖 1），巴拿馬運河缺水將更加嚴重；  宏遠 估裕民 2026 年稅
後 EPS  + 8.22 元，YoY + 91%，創 18 年新高 ； 持續 建議買進 。

貳、公 司 概 況 
一.公司簡介  
截至 2026 年 5 月（法說資料），裕民實際經營船隻為 71 艘：  
海岬型船   25 艘：自有 22 艘 + 3 艘合資。  
巴拿馬型船 24 艘：自有 14 艘 + 7 艘代管  + 3 艘合資 。 
輕便型      8 艘（自有） 。 
水泥船      4 艘（自有） 。 
油輪        4 艘：透過  環能海運 （持股 40% ）。 
CTV 離岸風電人員運輸船 6 艘（自有  ； 裕民風能航運 ）。

在建船隻  12 艘，交船時程 ： 
202 6 年： 輕便型  1 艘（預期 11 月交付）。 
202 7 年 及 2028 年： 
海岬型  4 艘 + 輕便型  5 艘 + 風電工程船  2 艘。

二.營運概況 及展望  
1.超級聖嬰 造成缺水  撞上  巴拿馬運河乾季，壓抑海運供給  
2026 年 5 月，全球進入聖嬰年，加劇全球乾旱與極端高溫 的
氣候異常 。 聯合國  世界氣象組織（ WMO ）表示， 這波聖嬰
現象，可能是過去  40 年最強一次，幾乎肯定會持續到  2027
年 2 月，很可能打破  2023 年 ~ 2024 年的紀錄 。

巴拿馬運河溝通大西洋與太平洋，節省海運船舶至少  3,000
海哩的航程，航行時間縮短  2 週左右。

但由於 大西洋與太平洋的海平面和水流高度不同，船隻 要透
過 巴 拿 馬 運 河 ，橫 跨 美 洲 ， 必 須依 靠 巴 拿 馬 運 河 的船閘 注
水，採取類似 爬樓梯一樣 的升降 動作 ，讓船 隻從海平面被提
升到高處的加通湖，穿過湖面後，再降回另一側的海平面。
每艘船舶 每次通過船閘，都需要消耗  加通湖  數以百萬加侖
計算的淡水。

因此， 加通湖的水量多寡 ，會影響巴拿馬運河的運作效率與
容量 ，一旦缺水，巴拿馬運河每日通行船舶數量就會減少。

觀察過去 5 年（2021 年 ~ 2025 年）加通湖的水位資料（參閱
圖 1） ，通常會從每年 5 月，逐月爬升到  12 月；  但 2026 年
超級聖嬰的乾旱，造成目前 9 月水位不升反降 。 
以現貨為主，長約為輔 
總船隊 71 艘 
全球 超級聖嬰 極端氣候 
從 2026 年 5 月 至少持續 
至 2027 年 2 月

巴拿美運河 季節性乾季 從 
每年 12 月 持續至 隔年 5 月

聖嬰 + 乾季

最快必須等到 2027 年 2H

2026 年 5 月起，全球 超級聖嬰 ，帶來的 乾旱，至少將持續到
2027 年 2 月 ； 如此，將撞上  加通湖  每年  例行 的 季節 性 
乾季 （每年 12 月 ~ 隔年 5 月 ； 參閱圖 1 ）。

因此， 巴拿馬運河（ 加通湖）的缺水很可能會持續加重，最
快的解除時間可能要等到  2027 年 2H。

巴拿馬運河  每日正常通行量  36 ~ 40 艘。 
2023 年 ~ 2024 年 全球 聖嬰 造成乾旱  巴拿馬運河的 每日船
舶通行量最低降至  18 艘。

目前  加通湖  尚未進入  季節性乾季，但 受制於全球聖嬰現
象， 加通湖  水位  已經 提前 明顯降低 ； 巴拿馬運河管理當
局， 已經 宣布，巴拿馬運河每日船舶通行數量， 2026 年 9 月
3 日降至  34 艘 ； 9 月 15 日降至  32 艘。

宏遠預期， 巴拿馬運河降低每日船舶通行數量的趨勢，將日
益嚴重， 壓抑所有的海運供給 ，將有利於推升各型船舶的運
價，拉高海運航商獲利 。

2.散裝 BDI 走勢，隱示  2026 年獲利  將大幅優於  2025 年 
2026 年截至 9 月 8 日，散裝 BDI 運價走勢都優於 2025 年同期
表現（ 參閱圖 2） 。 
受惠於 BDI 的強勁走勢 ，裕民 ： 
1Q / 2026 稅後 EPS + 1.17 元，優於  1Q / 2025 同期  + 0.27 元。 
2Q / 2026 稅後 EPS + 2.34 元，優於  2Q / 2025 同期  + 0.77 元。

從 BDI 的表現來看：  
1Q / 2026 （過年淡季） BDI 平均  1,955 。 
2Q / 2026 （美伊戰爭爆發， 燃煤替代天然氣） BDI 平均  2,751 。 
3Q / 2026 （截至 9 月 8 日） BDI 平均  2,928。 
2026 年 9 月 8 日 單日  BDI  3,584 。

4Q 是散裝 航運的 季節性 旺季，遇上， 荷姆斯海峽封閉  推升  
煤 炭 的 海 運 需 求  及   巴 拿 馬 運 河 缺 水 降低  海運船舶供
給（繞道等同減少供給） ； 預期 4Q 的 BDI 將會持續強勁。

BDI 漲勢 強勁，宏遠預期 裕民  3Q ~ 4Q / 2026 單季獲利 YoY 大
幅成長 ； 未來， 3Q 及 4Q 財報發布 ，將激勵股價表現 。

### Page 1

Summary: Driven by strong AI/HPC demand, all three companies set new revenue 
milestones: Winway (TWD 1.71bn, +6.6% MoM, +233.4% YoY), MPI (TWD 2.05bn, 
+13.4% MoM, +69.9% YoY), and CHPT (TWD 638m, +3.9% MoM, +54.3% YoY). With 
Winway’s capacity expansions tracking ahead of schedule, MPI set to begin shipping CPO 
insertion 3 products in 4Q26 alongside ASP hikes in late-3Q26, and CHPT nearing a 
qualification for its turnkey CPU ASIC project, the sector offers resilient sequential growth 
visibility through 2H26 and potential earnings upside heading into 2027.

What’s new: Following the conclusion of SEMICON Taiwan, we have observed a marked 
uptick in investor enquiries regarding the semiconductor test interface supply chain. As 
AI/HPC architectural transitions, and the increasing complexity of 2.5D/3D packaging drive 
structural content gains, investors have focused increasingly on capacity visibility and 
technological roadmaps across the socket and probe card segments. In the note, we recap 
the latest August monthly revenue figures and synthesize key market dynamics across our 
coverage universe.

WinWay Technology (6515 TT, TWD7,280, Buy [1]) 
• Aug revenue result: Monthly revenue reached TWD 1.71bn ( +6.6% MoM, +233.4% 
YoY), bringing 1-8M26 cumulative revenue to TWD 9.81bn (+97.9% YoY). Jul-Aug sales 
reached 72% of our 3Q26E revenue, tracking ahead of our expectations.

• Product mix & catalysts: Growth remains anchored by aggressive tape-outs from 
North American GPU leaders and cloud hyperscalers. Shipments of proprietary coaxial 
test sockets and advanced wafer-level vertical probe cards expanded sharply. While the 
market may expect meaningful revenue contributions from CPO sockets or probe cards, 
we believe it will account for mid-single digit in 2027E and high-single digit in 2028E.

• Outlook: The company maintained a constructive stance on order visibility and 
persistent demand-supply tightness. Management reaffirmed that 2Q26 marked the 
near-term cyclical trough, guiding for sequential revenue expansion on a QoQ basis 
moving forward. Our supply chain checks indicate that capacity expansion execution is 
tracking ahead of schedule compared with last month. With Winway poised to bring 
additional capacity online in 2027, we suggest investors monitor the company’s 2H26 
earnings call (mid-Nov) for further clarity on its 2027 capex and capacity roadmap.

• Valuation: We have a Buy (1) rating with a 12-month TP of TWD10,000, based on a 
target PER of 70x applied to our 4-quarter-forward EPS forecast. Based on our 
2027/28E EPS, the stock is currently trading at PERs of 36.9x/19.5x, vs. its previous 
highs of 80-90x. Downside risks: heavy reliance on major US AI chipmakers and; 2) 
intensifying competition that could erode design wins.

MPI Corporation (6223 TT, TWD5,615, Buy[1]) 
• Aug revenue result: Monthly revenue surpassed the TWD 2bn milestone for the first 
time, reaching TWD 2.05bn (+13.4% MoM, +69.9% YoY), bringing 1-8M26 cumulative 
revenue above TWD 13.0bn. Jul-Aug sales reached 63% of our 3Q26E revenue 
estimate, tracking slightly below our expectations.

• Product mix & catalysts: Vertical Probe Cards (VPC) and MEMS probe cards are 
operating at near-full capacity to support volume ramps in HPC, AI accelerators, and 
high-speed networking ICs. MPI’s AST (Advanced Semiconductor Test) and Thermal 
test chambers also maintained solid delivery momentum to European and US 
automotive and R&D laboratories. CPO insertion 3 engineering test equipment is 
scheduled for delivery in 4Q26, setting the stage for mass production orders in 1H27.

• Outlook: Although management’s muted 3Q26 guidance initially fuelled investor 
scepticism, and the cumulative 2M26 run-rate is tracking slightly behind our quarterly 
forecast, we view the market’s pessimism as overly conservative. Strong late-quarter 
shipment seasonality, coupled with concentrated September revenue recognition for 
high-end VPC/MEMS probe cards under the newly effective pricing schedule should 
help bridge the gap and keep 3Q26 on track to meet or exceed our top-line 
expectations. Looking into 4Q26 and early 2027, the commercial rollout of CPO 
insertion 3 equipment and continued certification progress for insertion 2 provide a multi-
year growth runaway and durable operating leverage.

• Valuation: We have a Buy (1) rating with a 12-month TP of TWD8,415, based on a 
target PER of 65x applied to our 4-quarter-forward EPS forecast. Based on our 
2027/28E EPS, the stock is currently trading at PERs of 42.9x/26.0x, vs. its peak of 80x. 
Downside risks: 1) Competitive and pricing pressure; and 2) delays due to AI/HPC 
slowdown.

Chunghwa Precision Test Tech (CHPT, 6510 TT, TWD3,610, Buy [1]) 
• Aug revenue result: August revenue totalled TWD 638m (+3.9% MoM, +54.3% YoY), 
bringing 1-8M26 cumulative revenue to TWD 4.25bn (+33.14% YoY). Jul-Aug sales 
reached 66% of our 3Q26E revenue, tracking in line with our expectations. In response 
to Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE) inquiries following recent share price volatility, CHPT 
disclosed its August financial results. Single-month EPS came in at TWD 5.29 (net 
income of TWD 174m, +95% YoY), implying a quarterly EPS run-rate of TWD 15.87 (vs 
Daiwa estimate of TWD 16.08 and market consensus of TWD 17.52)

• Product mix & catalysts: Top-line momentum was broad-based across both the AI 
GPU and ASIC segments. Management highlighted ongoing footprint expansion and 
continued efforts to identify additional sites to scale manufacturing capacity. Moving 
forward, steady deliveries of AI GPU test boards, alongside the forthcoming volume 
ramp of custom AI ASICs, should underpin sequential revenue growth.

• Outlook: Our supply chain checks indicate CHPT is competing for three AI/HPC probe 
card turnkey programs, comprising a CPU ASIC, an AI ASIC program for a US 
automotive client, and another AI ASIC program for Taiwanese clients. The automaker 
qualification process is progressing smoothly, and CHPT plans to ship engineering 
probe cards for validation in November, with validation results expected by end-2026. 
Given the superior content value of probe card solutions versus board-only products, a 
successful qualification would provide incremental top-line upside into late-2026, while 
serving as a significant catalyst for 2027 revenue upgrades and valuation expansion.

• Valuation: We have a Buy (1) rating with a 12-month TP of TWD4,000, based on a 
target PER of 45x applied to our 4-quarter-forward EPS forecast. Based on our 
2027/28E EPS, the stock is currently trading at PERs of 30.2x/24.0x, vs. its peak of 68x. 
Downside risks: 1) project delays and utilisation risk; and 2) loss of market share.

Document 087: 260910_gs_TSMC

Source PDF: all report pdf/260910_gs_TSMC.pdf
Report source: line報告備份
Date: 2026-09-10
Pages: 10
Status: ok

### Page 1

Presenters: Wendell Huang, SVP & CFO  
Bottom Line: We have three key takeaways: (1) TSMC continues to view AI as a 
multi-year megatrend that remains at a very early stage, with lower compute costs 
expected to accelerate AI adoption and ultimately drive greater demand for 
advanced silicon; (2) execution in Arizona continues to progress well, with Phase 1 
achieving yields comparable to Taiwan and already generating profits, while TSMC 
expects approximately 30% of its N2-and-beyond capacity to be located outside 
Taiwan in five years, primarily in Arizona; and (3) despite dilution from the N2 ramp 
and overseas expansion, management remains comfortable achieving its long-term 
gross margin target of 56% and above, supported by disciplined capacity planning, 
high utilization, productivity improvements, cost reductions, and pricing that reflects 
TSMC’s value. 
Key Takeaways

AI remains in the early stages of a multi-year megatrend: TSMC continues to n
see increasing adoption of AI. Management also highlighted the shift from 
generative AI toward agentic AI, which should broaden compute demand 
beyond accelerators to CPUs. TSMC remains confident in the durability of the AI 
cycle based on discussions not only with its direct customers but also with its 
customers’ customers. Recent visits of US CSPs further reinforced management’s 
confidence, as cloud service providers appeared well prepared in areas including 
power and broader infrastructure deployment. 
Lower compute costs should drive greater consumption and silicon demand: n
Management believes open-source models and continued improvements in 
computing efficiency will reduce token costs, leading to greater AI 
consumption and broader adoption, supporting incremental demand for 
advanced silicon. TSMC has already incorporated this dynamic into its capacity 
planning and continues to expand aggressively to support what it views as

### Page 2

structural, multi-year demand growth.
Disciplined demand validation remains critical amid aggressive expansion: n
TSMC uses a combination of top-down and bottom-up analysis to validate demand.
Its top-down assessment considers macroeconomic conditions, semiconductor
demand, fabless/system companies, the foundry industry, etc, while its bottom-up
approach evaluates demand across different segments and incorporates feedback
from customers and customers’ customers. Management acknowledged that

semiconductors will remain cyclical, but believes correctly identifying the underlying
megatrend is more important than attempting to forecast every short-term
fluctuation.
Arizona execution is demonstrating that TSMC’s manufacturing model can n
travel: TSMC reiterated that overseas expansion is based on customer demand for
geographic flexibility and an appropriate level of government support. Arizona
Phase 1, using N4 technology, is in operation, with yields comparable to Taiwan,

satisfactory quality and reliability, and positive profitability. Management views
this as an important milestone because it demonstrates internally and to customers
that TSMC can produce wafers in the US with the same quality as in Taiwan.
Equipment move-in for Phase 2, which will use N3 technology, is expected to begin
soon; construction of Phase 3 has started; and preparation work for Phase 4 and the
first US advanced-packaging facility is underway.

Arizona has substantial room for further expansion: In addition to its original n
Arizona development, TSMC has acquired another parcel of land capable of
accommodating an additional five to six fabs, supporting its recently
announced incremental US$100bn investment. Based on its current plan, TSMC
expects approximately 30% of its N2-and-beyond capacity to be located outside
Taiwan in five years, primarily in Arizona. However, the most advanced technologies

will continue to ramp first in Taiwan because the early-stage technology transfer
requires close collaboration and frequent movement of engineers among R&D and
manufacturing sites. Overseas deployment will generally follow after the technology
has stabilized in Taiwan.
Customers increasingly value and are willing to pay for geographic flexibility: n
Management noted that customers initially requested only a modest amount of
geographically diversified supply, but their requirements have increased as TSMC has

demonstrated successful execution in Arizona. TSMC believes this geographic
flexibility represents incremental value and intends to reflect that value in its pricing,
with customers increasingly willing to recognize the associated premium.
Technology, manufacturing excellence, capacity, and trust underpin TSMC’s n
competitive moat: Management believes customers select a foundry partner based
on access to the best technology, the ability to ramp rapidly into high-volume

manufacturing with attractive economics, sufficient capacity, and confidence that
the foundry will not compete with its customers. TSMC is confident in maintaining
this lead by continuing to advance its roadmap. Management also highlighted its
record of rapidly ramping new technologies, the scale of its wafer and
advanced-packaging investments, and its consistent delivery against customer
10 September 2026   2
Goldman Sachs TSMC (2330.TW)For the exclusive use of KEVINLU@LENOVO.COM

e92c7a75ab8b4efbba794e6b187208c8

### Page 3

commitments as key elements of customer trust that cannot be replicated through
CapEx or engineering recruitment alone.
Pricing remains strategic rather than opportunistic: TSMC does not intend to raise n
prices simply because near-term utilization is high, nor reduce prices simply because
utilization temporarily weakens. Instead, the company’s approach is to price
sustainably and consistently based on the value it provides, while ensuring that
customers can remain successful over the long term. Management noted that

TSMC’s structural profitability has continued to improve, with its long-term gross
margin target increasing from 50% five years ago to 53% and now 56% and above.
Leading-edge wafer and advanced-packaging capacity remain tight: n
Management continues to build capacity wherever possible to meet customer
demand. N3 demand remains particularly strong: unlike prior technology cycles,
when demand for a node typically began declining two to three years after its

introduction, TSMC is adding further N3 capacity and still does not expect supply
to be sufficient. The company is also expanding advanced-packaging capacity to
address strong accelerator demand. Outside TSMC, management identified power
and memory as potential bottlenecks cited by other parts of the AI supply chain,
while emphasizing that foundry capacity itself remains difficult to expand because
fabs require two to three years to build and another one to two years to ramp.

TSMC’s disclosed AI revenue understates its broader exposure: Management n
reiterated that its disclosed AI revenue definition is relatively narrow and primarily
captures GPUs, custom AI accelerators and memory base die. It excludes CPUs and
networking products because TSMC cannot reliably determine whether each chip is
ultimately deployed in an AI system. As agentic AI drives incremental demand across
x86, Arm, and RISC-V CPUs, as well as networking and other supporting silicon,

TSMC’s total AI-related exposure is therefore broader than its reported
AI-accelerator revenue. The company intends to retain its existing definition until it
can more accurately distinguish the end use of these products.
No visible barrier to continued transistor scaling: TSMC is currently ramping N2, n
with A14 expected approximately two years later, while development of the
subsequent node is already underway. Management does not currently see a

technical issue preventing delivery of the next node or continued advancement
beyond the existing roadmap. TSMC views close collaboration with customers as a
key foundry advantage, allowing the company to develop each technology against
specific customer performance, power, density, and economic requirements.
Cross-node capacity optimization is an underappreciated advantage: TSMC n
highlighted its ability to generate additional output through productivity

improvements and to convert tools and capacity across technology nodes. For
example, the company can use portions of its N5 capacity to support N3 demand
and can also optimize capacity across less-adjacent nodes where technically
feasible. Management views this cross-node flexibility as a distinctive element of
TSMC’s manufacturing excellence, allowing the company to respond more
quickly to demand changes while reducing the risk of capacity obsolescence.

Advanced packaging is strategic primarily because it enables wafer growth: n
10 September 2026   3
Goldman Sachs TSMC (2330.TW)For the exclusive use of KEVINLU@LENOVO.COM
e92c7a75ab8b4efbba794e6b187208c8

### Page 4

CoWoS capacity remains tight, and TSMC already started outsourcing selected 
packaging processes to OSAT partners to support additional growth. Management 
emphasized that advanced packaging is intended primarily to ensure and enable 
wafer demand rather than serve as a standalone profit pool. TSMC is therefore 
developing multiple packaging architectures, including panel-level packaging, etc, 
while remaining open to customers using alternative packaging providers, as either 
approach ultimately supports demand for TSMC wafers. 
Advanced-packaging execution remains a key differentiator: TSMC noted that its n
current advanced-packaging capability supports approximately 5.5x reticle size, 
with a roadmap to reach approximately 14x reticle sizes within the next several 
years. While competing roadmaps may also appear attractive, management believes 
execution and the ability to deliver in high-volume manufacturing will ultimately 
determine competitive outcomes. TSMC does not believe competitors can use 
advanced-packaging wins to meaningfully displace its leading-edge wafer 
business, as foundry and packaging remain fundamentally different businesses. 
A unified TSMC culture supports overseas manufacturing execution: TSMC’s n
objective is not to create separate Taiwan and US cultures, but to establish a 
consistent TSMC culture centered on integrity, commitment, innovation, and 
customer trust (ICIC). Locally hired Arizona employees spend six to eighteen months 
training and working in Taiwan, while experienced Taiwan-based employees are 
assigned to Arizona to work alongside local teams. Over time, the number of Taiwan 
assignees should decline as locally trained employees assume greater responsibility. 
TSMC is applying this approach across its overseas manufacturing sites. 
Management remains comfortable with its 56%-and-above long-term gross n
margin target: TSMC reiterated its 6 major drivers of profitability: new-technology 
ramp, pricing, cost, product mix, utilization, and FX. The N2 ramp is expected to 
dilute 2026 GM by approximately 2-3ppts, but its profitability should improve over 
time toward the corporate average; management also noted that N2’s structural 
profitability is better than N3 at a comparable stage. Overseas expansion is 
expected to dilute GM by 2-3ppts during the early portion of the current five-year 
period, then widening to 3-ppts later as more overseas fabs begin production. Each 
new fab will initially create dilution before improving along its learning curve. Taking 
these puts and takes together, management remains very comfortable that 
disciplined capacity planning, healthy utilization, cost reduction, productivity 
gains, and pricing that reflects TSMC’s value will enable the company to deliver 
for shareholders and achieve its long-term gross margin target ‘of 56% and 
higher’ with focus on the ‘higher’ side. 
Valuation/Risks

TSMC (Buy): Our 12-month price target is NT$3,100, which is derived by applying a 
target P/E multiple of 22x to our 2027E EPS. Our 22x target P/E is benchmarked against 
1.0stdv above its 5-year trading average. For the ADR (TSM), we have a 12-month price 
target of US$620, based on a USD/TWD rate of 30.0 and an ADR premium of 20%. Key

Global Research
First Read
Advantech
UBS Taiwan Summit 2026 key takeaways: Four
growth engines to drive robust orders
Upbeat FY26 outlook reinforced
Advantech delivered a positive message at the UBS 2026 Taiwan Summit, backed by an
upward-trending monthly book-to-bill (BB) ratio and accumulating design win projects
in its major market in the US. The company continues to see solid order placement, not
impacted by higher pricing. Advantech's component sourcing further improved QoQ to

support robust order momentum. On profitability, Advantech can pass on over 70% of
component cost increases. Despite positive operating leverage, management noted
possibly higher opex due to restricted stock award (RSA) expenses, which have relatively
higher amortization during the first few years, starting in 2027.
Leading indicators support robust order growth
Advantech's sustained order momentum is not impacted by higher pricing, with no
signs of client double booking. Some clients even offer 100% down-payments seeking

Advantech's on-time delivery. Management sees an upward trending BB ratio, healthy
at less than 2x.  Pipeline visibility is further reinforced by North American design wins of
US$444m in H126. Orders are mainly supported by three major end applications: 1)
factory automation (particularly AMRs and cobots), semi equipment (front- and back-
end equipment), 2) healthcare, 3) green energy infrastructure.   Management expects
those and edge AI projects to be the major  order drivers in the next three to five years.

Margin pressure to ease as component headwinds subside
Advantech’s GM fell to 37.7% in Q226 due to escalating component costs, particularly
across tech inputs such as GPUs, CPUs, MLCCs, memory and PCBs. After initial price
hikes in Oct 2025, Advantech has maintained bi-weekly price adjustments for board
products and monthly adjustments for systems in 2026, allowing it to pass on over 70%
of cost increases. To mitigate supply constraints, Advantech has signed LTAs and

qualified more alternative component suppliers. It has also worked through specialized
PCB bottlenecks. Its supply sufficiency has further improved in Q326 vs. Q226.
Management maintained  guidance of flat QoQ GM and OPM for Q326, while remaining
confident the long-term GM will recover to its historical 39–40% range and OPM will
continue to trend upward, driven by expanding operating leverage.
Valuation: Raise price target to NT$782; maintain Buy

We raise our 2026-28E earnings, mainly to reflect: 1) stronger-than-expected top-line
growth; 2) lower GM on continued input cost pressure and time lags for price increases
to be reflected in its P&L; and 3) possibly higher opex starting in 2027 on RSA expense
amortization. The RSA was  approved by the board but not yet issued, pending
regulatory authority approval. We raise our price target from NT$744 to NT$782 and
reiterate our Buy rating on the solid top-line momentum.

Company Description
Established in 1981 and listed on the Taiex in 1999, Advantech is a world-leading Taiwanese
IPC supplier. Its product offerings involve embedded boards and chassis, industrial computers
and controls, and after-sales services with applications spanning manufacturing automation,

healthcare, transportation, energy and networking industries. To serve the global market, it
has three manufacturing sites in Taiwan, Japan and China and direct subsidiaries in 27
countries.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement
We base our price target for Advantech on 30x 2027E PE.
Industrial PC sector risks include: slower global economic growth; uncertain trade tariff
negotiations; higher interest rates that could result in weaker capex investment; readiness

and supply chain bottlenecks of IT technology that could slow project execution; currency
movement; and changes in component pricing that could bring downside to profitability.
In our view, key company-specific risks include: 1) slower-than-expected edge-AI product
adoption; 2) competition in the non-AI IPC segment, especially in China; 3) rising component
prices; 4) NTD appreciation against the USD; 5) slower macroeconomic growth that could
negatively impact overall capex allocation; and 6) demand growth that could attract more

new suppliers to join the market, which may intensify competition and possibly bring price
pressure.

First Read
Global Unichip
2026 Taiwan Summit:  CPU momentum and
ADAS projects support 2027F outlook
FY26 revenue outlook revised higher on improved wafer support
GUC attended our 2026 Taiwan Summit on Sep 14th. August revenue of NT$5,840mn
(+1%MoM/+111%YoY) is tracking above at 73%/75% of UBSe/Street +15%/+11%
QoQ. Following better-than-expected wafer support from TSMC, management raised its
FY26 revenue growth guidance from 36% YoY to approximately 100% in late-July, with

turnkey revenue expected to grow by over 100% and NRE revenue by high teens %.
Management maintained its 2026 corporate GM target of 20%+, despite rising revenue
contribution from its top  CPU customer. OPEX is expected to increase by high teens %
YoY, due to the new Turing center and higher employee bonuses, but strong revenue
growth should still drive meaningful operating leverage.
CPU project supports near-term growth and deepen CSP engagement

CPU turnkey project for the top CSP remains the main growth driver in H226F,
supported by increased wafer allocations for both the CPU project and GUC’s other top
customers. While the current CPU project carries a relatively lower margin given leading
CSP's extensive in-house design efforts, it has also strengthened GUC's customer
relationships. This has helped it secure the next-generation dual-die  CPU project, which
carries higher content and ASP and  should see initial revenue from late-2026 with more

significant revenue contribution in 2027E. GUC is also pursuing ASIC  accelerator
opportunities with the top CSP customer and the other major CSPs, although
management does not expect meaningful turnkey revenue before 2028.
Broader customer exposure supports medium-term growth
Beyond the current CPU ramp, GUC sees incremental growth opportunities across
ADAS, other CSP CPU/ASIC business, and CPO. Chinese customers'  ADAS turnkey
revenue is expected to begin in late 2026F, followed by a its U.S. 3nm ADAS project in

H227F, with both carrying higher margins than the current CPU program, although the
U.S. customer's ramp will depend on TSMC's capacity support. For the other CSP
customer, management expects revenue contribution from both CPU and ASIC   to begin
in H226F and could become another key  revenue driver in 2027. It is also working with
this CSP customer for Gen 3 and bidding on Gen 4 project. Although  CPO remains at an
early stage, GUC and its partners plan for  tape out  on TSMC’s COUPE by end-2026,

offering longer-term margin support given GUC’s greater involvement in chip design.
Valuation: Maintain Buy rating with a P/E-based price target of NT$6,700
We rate GUC BUY with a PT of  NT$6,700, based on 50x average 2027-28E EPS (vs
historical 15-62x range), supported by 52% CAGR in earnings over 2025-30E. We
reiterate that GUC should benefit from Google CPU upside and multiple automotive
project ramps.

Company Description
Global Unichip (GUC) is a leading IC design service company in Taiwan, founded in 1998. The
company's business is to design chipsets for customers that do not have IC design capability,
with the goal of reducing entry barriers and risks for chipset design and shortening the time

to market. The company's target to enable more IC design for start-ups and system
companies is complimentary with TSMC, which would benefit from a growing customer and
application base, in addition to the company's existing IC design and IDM customers.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement
We value Global Unichip based on a PE methodology.
Downside risks include a slower-than-expected business recovery for mature node, lack of
new project wins, and wafer capacity constraints.

### Page 1

Poya  (5904.TWO)
Positives Mostly Priced In; Downgrade to Neutral 
CITI'S TAKE 
We downgrade Poya to Neutral from Buy following its strong YTD share price 
performance. Although operating momentum remains positive in the near-
term (we expect a strong Sep SSSG and solid 3Q earnings), we believe the 
rally has already reflected much of the benefit from robust SSSG YTD and 
margin expansion. Looking ahead, tough comparisons from 4Q26E may 
make solid SSSG harder to sustain, limiting earnings upside and potential 
weighing on stock sentiment. Meanwhile, Cosmed’s expanding rollout of 
Olive Young brands adds to competition pressure for beauty spending. We 
trim our DCF-based TP to NT$70, implying 18x NTM P/E vs. 5-year mean of 
17x. We view current risk/reward as balanced. 
Strong performance leaves less room for further upside — Poya’s shares have 
rallied 73% YTD, outperforming the benchmark’s 57% gain and broadly flat 
performance for the TW retail sector. This reflects strong operating deliver, including 
6-7% YTD SSSG and solid margin expansion supported by op leverage and 
headcount optimization. While the company may continue to grow earnings through 
store expansion and productivity improvements, we believe much of this outlook is 
already priced in. Further share price appreciation may require additional earnings 
upside, which could become more difficult to deliver if SSSG moderates. 
Tougher comp from 4Q26E could temper SSSG momentum — Poya’s YTD SSSG 
has benefited from 4-5% ticket growth, partly reflecting price inflation, as well as 
traffic growth 1-2%. We expect the comp base to become more demanding from 
4Q26E onward, increasing the hurdle for keeping the current growth rate. Slower 
SSSG could reduce incremental op leverage and limit further margin expansion. 
Given its YTD rally, a shift to positive but slower growth could weigh on sentiment. 
Cosmed’s Olive Young rollout raises competition pressure — Cosmed introduced 
four Olive Young, Korea’s leading beauty retail channel, proprietary brands in late 
Dec 2025 and planned to expand dedicated sections to 120 stores by end-2026E 
( ~20% of Cosmed’s total store count), increasing local access to popular Korean 
beauty products. Per Cosmed, PSD at locations carrying OY brands increased by 
MSD y/y YTD vs. MSD y/y down across its overall network, suggesting the brands are 
gaining customer interest. We believe broader availability and product selection 
could intensity competition for customer visits and beauty spending, potentially 
slowing Poya’s traffic growth and increasing promotional pressure.  (continued)

Poya (5904.TWO): Positives Mostly Priced In;
Downgrade to Neutral
Implications — We keep our earnings estimates largely unchanged for 2026-
2028E yet we trim our DCF-based TP to NT$70 from prior NT$74.5 mainly to factor
in a lower terminal growth of 4.5% (down from 5%). We also factor in its stock split
in Aug 2026. Our target price of NT$70 implies an 18x NTM forward P/E vs its 5-
year historical mean of 17x, which looks balanced to us.

We believe Poya’s store expansion and efficiency improvements may continue to
support earnings, but we see limited scope for further re-rating given the earnings
growth moderation (net profits +9% y/y in 2027E vs. +27% y/y in 2026E based on
our estimate) and its strong share-price gains to date. T ougher comparisons and
rising competition add uncertainty around the durability of SSSG momentum and
margin expansion.
We would prefer to see sustained traffic growth through the higher comp base,

clearer evidence of additional earnings upside or a more attractive entry point
before becoming more positive on the shares.

Poya
Company description
Poya is the largest retailer of fast-moving consumer goods in Taiwan, focusing
on low-priced cosmetics, accessories, clothing and food products for females
aged 15-49. Poya had 470 stores in Taiwan at the end of 2025 and believes
that the market can accommodate up to 700-800 stores before reaching
saturation.
Investment strategy
We have a Neutral rating on Poya. We think YTD rally has baked in most

positives, including strong SSSG and solid margin expansion. While
fundamentals remain solid, tougher comparisons from 4Q26E could
moderate this year's 6-7% SSSG, lowering operating leverage and capping
further earnings upside. Meanwhile, Cosmed's expanding rollout of Olive
Young brands is intensifying competition for beauty spending. Although
Poya's SSSG has remained resilient, braoder distribution of these brands
could divert customer traffic and increase promotional pressure. We continue

to recognize Poya's execution in store expansion and ongoing efficiency
improvements. However, with these strengths largely reflected in the share
price and growth momentum facing a higher hurdle from 4Q26E onward, we
see a more balanced risk/reward.
Valuation
We derive our 12-month target price of NT$70 for Poya from a DCF valuation
method. Our assumptions include a terminal growth rate of 4.5% and WACC
of 10.1% (beta of 1.05; risk-free rate of 4%; risk premium of 7.0%; cost of equity

of 11.3%). Our target price implies a P/E of 18x on our NTM EPS.
Risks
Key downside risks that could mean the shares fail to achieve our target price
include: intense price competition among online retailers, slower store traffic,
margin dilution due to aggressive store expansion, and a soft macro
environment.
Key upside risks that could mean the shares fail to achieve our target price
include: easing price competition among online retailers, stronger store

traffic, margin expansion thanks to strong cost control, and a stronger macro
environment.

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.

### Page 1

ab 18 September 2026
Global Research
Nanya Technology
Pricing reset driving upside in 3Q
3Q26 tracking well ahead of consensus
Nanya Tech's July ’26 revs were up 49% MoM and August 2%. Combined, July+August
is equivalent to 80% of VA consensus 3Q revenue of NT$111bn. We understand this
comes from both DRAM bit shipments and ASP upside. We now forecast QoQ bits up
5% vs -8% prior. More noticeably, we now forecast DRAM ASPs up 50% QoQ (vs.
+32% prior). We believe this comes from some 6-month to 1-year contracts which re-

set last July, leading to well above average QoQ pricing momentum. Also, with niche
DRAM exposure and less concentration around large clients, Nanya’s DRAM ASPs are
edging higher than its much larger peers as the upcycle continues. Looking into 4Q26,
we forecast ASPs to increase 10% QoQ. With that, gross margin should improve in
3Q26 to 86.1% from 79.5% in 2Q, and remain at elevated levels throughout 2027.
Reiterate Buy.
Not fulfilling customers’ demand until the next fab ramps

Nanya sees 50-60% fulfillment rate for demand currently. Several large customers are
not getting any allocation. Long term agreements cover >60% of bits already. Its new
fab will start equipment moving-in in 1Q27, with initial output in 3Q27. Initial capacity
will reach 30k wpm by 2028, with total theoretical capacity of 45-50k wpm. Nanya is
also constructing an EUV litho building with equipment moving in in 1Q28. The goal is
to secure 2 tools with space up to 5. Up to its 1d nm (which is 1a nm equivalent), Nanya

does not require EUV litho.
Increasing forecasts
We increase 3Q26E revs/EPS estimates to NT$133bn/NT$26.44 (by 30%/40%),
20%/37% above Visible Alpha consensus of NT$110bn/NT$19.26. We also increase
2026E/2027E/2028E EPS forecasts by 23%/12%/18% respectively on higher
DRAM ASP assumptions (9%/9%/4% higher per Gb vs prior).
Valuation: PT to NT$640 from NT$555; maintain Buy
We value Nanya Tech shares at 3.16x NTM P/BV (was 3.01x) based on our LT
ROE estimate of 26.5% (was 25.5%) and CoE of 8.4% (was 8.5%).

Nanya Technology 18 September 2026 ab 2
Nanya Technology UBS ResearchNanya Tech (2408.TW)
Thesis Map     UBS                    Research     THESIS MAP a guide to our thinking and what´s where in this report
Q: Will DRAM undersupply continue into 2028?
Yes in our view. Agentic AI is boosting further memory demand on multiple fronts beyond HBM,
including DDR5/LPDDR5 for conventional servers and CPU head nodes in AI servers. We now forecast
an acceleration of memory demand growth into 2027 with DRAM bit end-consumption growing

40% YoY vs 21% in 2026. As almost all of the incremental wafer capacity addition for DRAM is
going to HBM, supply is not catching up with demand. The main risk remains affordability by
customers as memory industry revenues are expected to reach US$1.64tn in 2027E.
Q: Can NTC grow as a niche DRAM player?
Yes. 2026 and 2027 are likely to be years of more constrained growth. Subsequently though, we
think its process tech migration to 1c nm and 1d nm will likely lead to a 30% increase in bits per wafer

for each process tech migration (at comparable yields). NTC is also slightly pulling in its new fab ramp,
with equipment expected to move in 1Q27. We also see a tail of DDR3 and DDR4 products NTC can
address for a while.
Nanya Tech shares trade at 2.59x NTM P/BV, above +1SD of its 10-year average. That said, we believe
the strength of the unfolding DRAM cycle as well as the tail of legacy products that Nanya can
address as a niche player should continue to provide support for the stock.

Our industry checks suggest HBM demand continues to result in capacity allocation away from DDR,
which may moderate possible cyclical corrections, supporting upside to DDR contract pricing for
longer.
At 2.59x NTM P/BV, we believe Nanya Tech shares are discounting a LT average ROE of 21.7% vs our
LT estimate of 26.5%.

Company Description
Nanya Tech is a pure DRAM company based in Taiwan, focusing on legacy products for
consumers, broad-based applications and is now growing in servers.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement
Nanya Tech is a pure-play DRAM manufacturer based in Taiwan mainly focused on legacy DDR

products for customers across various end applications. We think downside risks to our thesis
could include a potential slowdown in end demand and hence the conventional memory
cycle as well as Nanya's legacy-centric product portfolio. We value Nanya Tech shares using a
target NTM P/BV multiple based on long-term average ROE and cost of equity.

Greater China Technology Hardware
Asia Pacific
Industry View In-Line
CCL –  Doosan announces
capacity expansion in Korea and
China
What’s new? According to Business Korea, Doosan (000150.KS, not covered)
announced a KRW970B CCL capacity expansion on Sep 17:
• KRW420B in Korea to add optical module CCL lines, and
• KRW550B in China to build a new plant for AI accelerator and network
switch CCL.
Spending is phased through 2028, with the new lines coming online sequentially

from 2H28.
Our thoughts:  Our checks suggest this investment could add ~2,000K sheets per
month of CCL capacity at Doosan, equivalent to ~2% of global CCL capacity in 2028,
on our estimates. We view the investment as further evidence of robust demand for
high-end CCL and do not believe it undermines our thesis of continued high-end CCL
scarcity (see our CCL initiation report). As such, we see a positive read-across for
EMC, TUC, and Shengyi. We remain OW on EMC and TUC, while maintaining our EW

communications with a subject company, public appearances
and trading securities held by a research analyst account.

Hon Precision (7769.TW)
21 September 2026 Citi Research
2
Hon Precision
Valuation
Our target price of NT$11,000 is based on a target PER multiple of 36x applied to the average of our 2027E/28E EPS estimates.
Our PER target of 35x is set at 1-std above its 1-year PER average, justified by its high share of the AI/HPC testing handler
market, which we estimate could support an earnings CAGR of 77% in 2025-28, higher than its 3-year CAGR at c40% in 2022-

25. Our estimated 77% earning CAGR is also higher than the +40% average (Bloomberg consensus) of its global testing
equipment peers. As its peers have been trading at  average  36x PER on 2027/28 consensus EPS in the past 1 year, we believe
Hon Precision deserves a further re-rating to our target PER of 36x.
Risks
Our quantitative risk rating system, which looks at historical share price volatility, rates Hon Precision High Risk. However, we
are not assigning a High Risk rating as we forecast an earnings CAGR of >75%, significantly stronger than the growth outlook

for its global peers. Also, we note its dominant position in AI/HPC handler market and expanding market TAM opportunity,
which support our constructive view over its growth outlook.
Key downside risks that could impede the shares from reaching our target price: 1) Global AI demand slowdown  driving weaker
capacity build for semiconductor equipment; 2) unexpected share losses at its major AI projects; 3) slower-than-expected
capacity ramp at its new facilities, or the company taking a long time to find/secure new sites; 4) slower-than-expected

development of its CPO business; 5) shorter-than-expected testing time leading to lower demand for its products; 6) weak
adoption of high-premium cold plate products; and 7) increasing competition from new entrants.

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.

### Page 1

Taiwan Information Technology

What’s new: We provide an update on Winway’s business outlook.

What’s the impact: Marked revenue upside, but a more conservative 
gross margin outlook. We raise our 3Q26 revenue forecast by 9.3% to 
TWD5.0bn (+177.8% YoY) to reflect the stronger-than-expected execution 
of capacity expansion at Renwu Phase 1. Management guided for flat QoQ 
revenue in 4Q26, due to: 1) seasonality; 2) existing capacity being nearly 
fully utilised, with additional capacity scheduled to come online in 1H27; 
and 3) potential revenue recognition delays into 1H27 to accommodate 
customers’ schedules. On profitability, we lower our 3Q26E gross margin 
by 1.8pp, as we expect higher revenue contribution from probe cards and 
incremental depreciation from the new plant to dilute margins. Overall, for 
2026E and 2027E, we raise our revenue by 3.2% and 0.9%, while lowering 
our gross margin by 1.2pp and 1.7pp, respectively.

Probe card share concerns appear overdone. In response to concerns 
over probe card order losses, we believe the expanding TAM will attract 
competitors; the key differentiator is whether suppliers can scale capacity 
to meet customers’ demands. Winway does not expect its probe card share 
at its largest customer to decline and remains confident in maintaining its 
market-leading position. Its Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems (MEMS) 
probe card supply agreement with Technoprobe (TPRO IM, Not Rated) 
remains in place, which should support its technology competitiveness.

Socket capacity expansion remains on track. Winway doubled its socket 
capacity YoY in 2026 and remains on track to reach monthly pogo-pin 
capacity of 14m units by 1H27, per management. We estimate monthly 
capacity to grow further to 16-18m units by end-2027. Management’s long-
term target is to raise its pogo-pin self-sufficiency ratio to 50-60%, which 
should support gross margin expansion through greater vertical integration.

What we recommend: We slightly raise revenue top-line but lower our 
2026-28E EPS by 1-5% to factor in conservative gross margin 
assumptions. We reaffirm our Buy (1) call, with 12M TP of TWD10,000, 
based on a PER of 50x, applied to our 2027E forward EPS. Our 2026-28E 
EPS CAGR of 100% makes our target PER undemanding, given that the 
resulting PEG ratio is 0.5x. Key downside risks: intensifying competition.

How we differ: Our revised 2026-27E EPS are now roughly in line with 
consensus, reflecting a more prudent gross margin. While market noise 
persists, we see no structural threat to Winway's leading position in sockets 
and probe cards.

21 September 2026

Capacity ramp drives revenue upside

➢ Revenue upside with more prudent gross margin assumptions 
➢ Probe card position intact; socket expansion on track 
➢ Reaffirming Buy (1) rating with an unchanged 12M TP of TWD10,000

Company profile 
Founded in Kaohsiung in 2001, WinWay has evolved from an optoelectronic test-fixture supplier into a 
leading logic test-interface provider. Its portfolio includes test sockets, MEMS probe cards and contact 
elements. Growth is driven by increasing AI/HPC testing complexity, GPU and ASIC design wins, 
expanding SLT adoption and next-generation HyperSocket solutions.

Wiwynn (6669.TW): New ASIC and GPU AI server racks in expansion; 
Aug strong beat; TP up to NT$3,777; Buy
21 September 2026 | 6:21AM HKT
Wiwynn delivered strong Aug revenues, which were 27% ahead of our estimates, 
reflecting strong general servers demand from US leading CSPs, and its major 
customers’ new ASIC AI servers ramping up. We expect sequential revenues growth 
to continue through Dec 2026, leading 3Q26 / 4Q26 revenues to grow at +46% / 
+22% QoQ, driven by (1) major customers’ new ASIC AI servers ramping up, across 
air-cooled and liquid-cooled, (2) general servers end demand remaining solid on 
agentic AI, (3) new GPU-powered AI server racks entering mass production in 4Q26 
across NVIDIA and AMD platforms, and (4) potential new customers in ASIC AI 
servers. Maintain Buy with TP raised to NT$3,777 (21.5x 2027E P/E vs. +32% EPS YoY 
in 2027-28E).

Ongoing capacity expansion: As we highlighted in Aug (report link), Wiwynn 
announced a 2H26 capex budget of US$942m, implying 2026 capex could be up to 
NT$40bn (US$1.3bn). On Sep 16, the company announced equipment procurement 
of US$16m (NT$512m), reflecting the strong AI demand and the company’s 
commitments on capacity expansion. We estimate the company’s capex at NT$44bn 
in 2026E, and to stay at a similar high level through 2028E, supporting its production 
sites diversification across the US, Mexico, and Malaysia, AI servers expansion from 
ASIC to GPU-powered, and products expansion across different ASICs and GPUs, 
along with further customers penetration. 
Earnings revision: We factor in August revenues, and change our net income by +7% 
/ +5% / +3% in 2026-28E. The change is mainly on revenues: we raise 2026-28E 
revenues by 8% / 7% / 5%, reflecting the strong beat of Aug revenues driven by

growing AI demand, which is also driving its general servers growth. Our EPS are reduced 
as we update the share count, reflecting the company’s stock split that started from 
Sept 2026. The mathematical effect on our EPS is around 66%.

Valuation: We continue to derive our 12M TP based on near-term P/E, and our 2027E 
target P/E increases slightly to 21.5x (vs. 20x previously), which is still derived from the 
peers’ updated correlation of forward trading P/E and EPS growth. Accordingly, our 12M 
TP increases by 13% to NT$3,777.00 (vs. NT$3,352.55 previously). Our target P/E of 
21.5x is above the company’s historical avg.+1stv. forward trading P/E, reflecting our 
positive view on Wiwynn’s leading position in ASIC AI server ODM along with product 
expansion (from ASIC to GPU AI servers and general server) and customers expansion. 
Maintain Buy.

### Page 3

Price Target Risks and Methodology - Wiwynn 
We are Buy-rated on Wiwynn with a 12-month TP of NT$3,777. Our target price is 
based on 21.5x 2027E P/E, which is derived from PC/server peers’ EPS growth vs. P/E 
multiple correlation. We see EPS growth as a major factor for the stock’s performance. 
Key downside risks: 1) weaker-than-expected AI server demand growth; 2) 
slower-than-expected recovery in general server demand; and 3) more severe 
competition in the server ODM market.

### Page 3

Price Target Risks and Methodology - Quanta 
We are Neutral-rated on Quanta. Our 12-month target price of NT$299 is based on an 
10.7x 2027E P/E, which references PC/server peers’ EPS growth vs. P/E multiple 
correlation. We see EPS growth as a major factor for the stock’s performance.  
Key upside/downside risks include: 1) stronger-/weaker-than-expected PC market 
recovery; 2) faster-/slower-than-expected AI server ramp-up; and 3) 
stronger-/weaker-than-expected demand for general servers.

再給我兩季度，讓泰國的產線轉盈

永豐觀點 
管理層預期 2026 年獲利低點在 2Q26，而我們對未來毛利率的改善速度存疑，係
因泰國二期擴產將持續壓抑獲利，認為 1 年內要回到過往 25-28%的結構性毛利
率區間仍有挑戰，並持續影響股價評價。 
 投資評價與建議 
目標價降至 347 元：京鼎能見度 9 個月以上，需求強度前所未見，但我們認為管
理層需透過毛利率的提升證明公司價值和競爭力，而不是客戶說擴就擴、說走就
走。預估 2026/2027 年 EPS 20.7/26.7 元，目前 PER 約 10.5x 在近年 8-17x 區間
中下緣，維持買進但對公司獲利改善速度存疑，故將目標價由 420 元(15x 2027 
EPSF)修至 347 元(13x 2027 EPSF)。

ESG 評析 
京鼎企業永續評鑑整體為 B+等，於 SASB 產業永續議題與跨產業五大永續面向平
均得分分別為 B+等與 B+等。

### Page 2

2

京鼎為半導體設備和系統整合廠：京鼎成立於 2001 年，為鴻海集團旗下之半導體
設備及系統整合公司，亦為國際大廠應用材料(AMAT US)之設備代工廠，目前主要
從事半導體、能源及面板設備製造服務及自主開發業務，員工人數4,524 人，目前
資本額 11.08 億新台幣。2Q26 營收依業務比重為：製造服務 85%、維修服務(半
導體零組件系統維修、CMP 研磨頭、富蘭登) 14%、自主開發(應用於晶圓製造、
先進封裝的非製程設備) 2%。生產據點位於台灣竹南和江蘇昆山、上海松江、美國
矽谷(NPI 廠)、 泰國羅勇廠 、 泰國春武里廠(3Q26 量產)。 主要客戶為應用材料(AMAT 
US)，2025 年佔營收約 84.8%。 
2Q26 毛利率為全年谷底：京鼎 2Q26 營收 63.0 億(+13.3%QoQ，+21.1%YoY)，
其中製造服務營收 53.6 億(+11.2%QoQ)受惠客戶對蝕刻、沉積、檢測等設備需求
成長、維修服務業務 8.8 億(+37.2%QoQ)主因為富蘭登航太專案營收貢獻，自主
開發營收 0.55 億(-43.6%QoQ)則受到微污染防治設備改版影響，毛利率22.3%為
2H19 以來新低，稅後淨利 4.7 億(+8.0%QoQ，+38.6%YoY)，EPS 4.61 元。獲利
表現低於預期主因(1) 毛利率因泰國春武里廠 2Q26 仍在量產初期 、 產品組合轉差
(檢測業務營收占比由 1Q26 的 12%提升至 14%)而低於預期，(2) 業外有匯兌損
失影響約 1.4 億。 
最壞狀況已過，毛利率回穩：管理層預期 3Q26 營運將維持逐季成長態勢，其中製
造服務受惠下游客戶對設備需求增加而成長 、 自主開發的微污染防治設備則隨客戶
完成驗收後有顯著成長、維修服務則因少了 6 月份認列的航太專案而下滑，更重
要的是，隨著檢測設備交易模式調整(部分關鍵料件改為客戶 Consign)，以及春武
里廠量產後規模效應放大，毛利率將開始改善。研究部預估京鼎 3Q26 營收 67.5
億(+7.2%QoQ，+21.9%YoY)，毛利率 22.9%，稅後淨利 6.1 億(+20.3%QoQ，-
7.9%YoY)，EPS 5.54 元。 
泰國廠啟動二期擴產：為因應客戶對 2028 年的產能需求，京鼎在8 月初通過泰國
子公司二期資本支出預算共 2.34 億美元，並於 2H26 開始進行土建發包與採購。
隨著一期設備陸續移入，預期泰國廠佔集團總產能比例將由目前的 15%，提升至
4Q26/2Q27 的 20%/25%，二期的設備則從 2H27 開始移入，將既有廠房空間填
滿且不需重新驗證，長期泰國廠 (羅勇及春武里合計 )將佔京鼎製造服務產能的
50%，成為台灣以外的第二大基地。獲利狀況上，羅勇廠在 2-3Q26 開始貢獻獲
利、春武里廠轉盈時點則落在 4Q26，且隨費用控制改案，營業費用率將落在

增加持股(Overweight) 
訂單需求持續強勁 ， 加快擴產速度  
⚫ 預期 2026 下半 年營收將逐季墊高  
⚫ 中國大陸強 勁成長， 2026 下半年轉 由日本驅動成長  
⚫ 產能持續擴 充 ，2026 年底 產能將 提升至 8,400 萬片  
預期 2026 下半年營收將逐季墊高 ：望隼 2Q26 營運表現強勁， 營收
12.0 億元 (QoQ+ 16%、YoY+37%)；毛利率 43.5%，較去年同期提升 2
個百分點，主要受惠稼動率滿載產生的規模經濟，以及製程持續優
化；帶動 營業利益率 提升至 31%，稅後淨利 2.8 億元 (YoY+86%)、EPS 
4.7 3 元。 展望 2026 下半年， 公司表示日本及中國大陸客戶訂單持續
回流，加上節慶備貨需求、矽水膠產品開始明顯 放量 ，以及新產能逐
步開出，營收有望逐季成長；毛利率則有望受惠稼動率持續高檔 及產
品組合優化 ，持穩於上半年的高水準 42~43% 。 
中國大陸強勁成長， 2026 下半年 由日本接棒 ：區域營運方面，中國大
陸佔比 54% 為主要營收來源 ，受惠定位彩片 引發的熱潮 ，前 7 月營收
YoY+55% 。日本市場佔比 35% ，雖因產能優先支援中國而 YoY-9%，
但隨著下半年產能轉向全力供應日本，預期業績將迎來強勁成長。台
灣市場受惠於 通路策略與 產品口碑發酵，營收 YoY+148% 。美國市場
則為長線佈局重點，公司持續積極推廣矽水膠產品，預計到 2027 年
下半年將有 較顯著客戶進 展，擴大整體海外市場。 公司 未來將結合多
焦、散光、抗藍光 等功能 於矽水膠 材質，持續 以差異化產品 擴大市佔 。 
產能持續擴充 ，2026 年底將來到 8,400 萬片 ：因應持續湧現的市場訂
單，望隼積極展開產能擴充計畫 。目前月產能近 7,000 萬片，稼動率
維持在高檔；並持續進行擴產工作， 預計至 2026 年底月產能將提升
至 8,400 萬片。 2027 年則以 1 億片為目標， 但具體擴產時間點仍會觀
察訂單和需求來決定 。產品組合 部分 ，2Q26 美瞳片佔比來到 58% ，
市 場對美 瞳片 需求持 續強 勁；矽 水膠 佔比 約 2%，已 開始出 貨日本 市
場，預期 2026 下半年在配合日本客戶新產品的上市，出貨量將進一
步放大，帶動矽水膠 全年營收佔比至 3~5% 。 
評價：以未來四季 預估 EPS 計算，給予 近年本益比區間中 緣 12.5 倍，
目標價 235 元，維持增加持股評等。 風險因子 ：矽水膠推廣不如預期 、
中國市場消費景氣變化、 匯率波動 。

Target Price：700

沛亨完成 2.4 億私募，主要將作為擴產及備料資金來源，反映出光
纖市場仍面臨漲價和供給緊張之現象 。6 月以來康寧再與 Amazon
簽訂供貨合約，Furukawa 也宣布在全球擴充光纜產品產能，顯現
光纖市場供給緊張的態勢並未緩解。綜合以上，研究部預估沛亨
2026 年 EPS 15.25 元，2027 年 EPS 26.17 元 ， 目前PE 為 18.7x，
考量光纖市場的供需緊張情境持續加劇 ， 另外沛亨在相對應的產能
規劃也不斷提高，因此維持目標價 700 元(PER 26x)，建議買進。 
⚫ 公司基本資料 
⚫ 公司基本資料 
沛亨半導體(6291)成立於 1992 年 ， 一開始本業為類比IC 設計廠，
2018 年加入振曜集團，目前產品分為網通產品（電源管理 IC、網
路產品）和電腦周邊（電聲元件、光纖）。其中光纖產品自 2022
年收購超昱光電後才加入業務，產品主要交給資料中心用光纖、跳
線，上游原材料來自於美系和日系大廠。2025 年產品組合電腦週
邊 65%、網通產品 35%。

沛亨 26Q2 營收 7.0 億元，Q+6.5%，Y+36.0%，毛利率 39.56%，
稅後淨利 1.4 億元，Q+11.6%，Y+918.3%，EPS 3.35 元。由於
筆電需求的疲弱壓抑電聲元件產品出貨 ， 抵銷來自於光纖產品的增
長，致使營收成長幅度低於研究部原先預期，不過產品組合的優化
下仍可見整體獲利水準持續改善，毛利率創下近 3 年來新高。

光纖產能持續擴充，完成私募 2.4 億作為備料資金 
沛亨 8 月營收 2.7 億元 ，M+10.5%，Y+33.4%，7 月營收 2.4 億元，
M+0.4%，Y+39.5%，7-8 月合計 5.1 億元，Y+36.2%。光纖產能
自 2025 年下半年開始陸續擴充，隨著新產線的投入和加班等帶動
光纖營收再度成長，此外公司也完成2.4 億元私募，資金預計作為
未來營運擴充及備料 ， 顯現整體光通產業面臨原料上漲及供給緊張
之情況。綜合以上，研究部預估沛亨 26Q3 營收 8.0 億元，
Q+13.4%，Y+38.9%，毛利率 39.88%，稅後淨利 1.7 億元，
Q+17.9%，Y+70.4%，EPS 3.95 元。

康寧又與 CSP 簽訂供應合約，Furukawa 積極擴充全球產能 
繼 Meta 和 NVIDIA 先後與康寧簽訂長期供貨合作後，6 月康寧再
與 Amazon 簽署數十億美元的多年期協議，以支應美國資料中心
擴建。此外，Furukawa 8 月宣布在已取得部分客戶長期採購承諾
下，將投資約 1000 億日圓，擴充美國、巴西、日本及印度的光纖
與光纜產能。各大 CSP 皆持續以長約鎖定供應、光纖大廠也同步
啟動擴產，顯示 AI 資料中心帶動的高密度光互連需求仍維持強
勁，光纖近年內仍將屬於供給緊俏市場。沛亨也同樣透過募資、母
公司貸與等方式進行籌資，作為產能擴充和原料準備的資金，預計
在新產線的加入下整體光纖營收仍可再有所提升 ， 惟消費性產品需

結論 
沛亨完成 2.4 億私募，主要將作為擴產及備料資金來源，反映出光
纖市場仍面臨漲價和供給緊張之現象。6 月以來康寧再與 Amazon
簽訂供貨合約，Furukawa 也宣布在全球擴充光纜產品產能，顯現
光纖市場供給緊張的態勢並未緩解。綜合以上，研究部預估沛亨
2026 年 EPS 15.25 元，2027 年 EPS 26.17 元 ， 目前PE 為 18.7x，
考量光纖市場的供需緊張情境持續加劇 ， 另外沛亨在相對應的產能
規劃也不斷提高，因此維持目標價 700 元(PER 26x)，建議買進。

 投資評價與建議

 重點評論分析 
2Q26營收與獲利維持成⻑ ， 惟原料上漲限制毛利率擴張 ：2Q26營收季增7.2%
至31.57億元，年增50.2%，受惠為銷售量及平均代工價調漲；毛利率與上季持
平為19.6%，主因原材料持續走升抵銷代工漲價效益，稅後EPS 0.97元。7~8
月營收累計達成率69%，優於預期，隨著代工價格調漲陸續反映原材料成本，
推估3Q26/4Q26分別季增6.6%/8.3%至33.67/36.48億元，毛利率19.8% / 
20%，稅後EPS 1.06/ 1.17元。 
記憶體需求遠大於供給，為代工封測迎來正向循環：AI應用持續擴張帶動記憶
體市場需求⼤幅成⻑，AI伺服器及⼀般伺服器對HBM及RDIMM需求排擠⼀般
型消費性記憶體，在國內廠商積極提高產出與擴充產能下，未來將同步拉升封
測代工需求。此外，模組產品代工方面，因顆粒價格上漲，使終端消費性電子
需求放緩；僅伺服器與工控記憶體模組需求穩定。目前四座工廠 （⼀廠、⼆廠、
3A、3B）稼動率達90%以上，主要產品以DDR4為主、DDR3為輔，並持續淘
汰低附加價值產品、將增加DDR4相關設備並進行廠內擴充；新五廠則預計明
年初量產貢獻營收。

| 營運概況  
2Q26 營收與獲利維持成，惟原料上漲限制毛利率擴張：2Q26 營收季增 7.2%至 31.57 億元，年增 50.2%，受惠
為銷售量及平均代工價調漲 ； 毛利率與上季持平為 19.6% ， 主因原材料持續走升抵銷代工漲價效益 ， 營業費用 1.35
億元，季增 33.7%，因銷管、研發費增加，營業利益率 15.4%，稅後淨利 4.29 億元，稅後 EPS 0.97 元。目前 7~8
月營收累計達成率 69%，優於預期，隨著代工價格調漲陸續反映原材料成本，推估 3Q26/4Q26 分別季增
6.6%/8.3%至 33.67/36.48 億元，毛利率 19.8% / 20%，稅後 EPS 1.06/ 1.17 元。 
記憶體需求遠大於供給，為代工封測迎來正向循環：由於 AI 應用持續擴張帶動記憶體市場需求⼤幅成⻑，AI 伺服
器及⼀般伺服器對 HBM 及 RDIMM 需求排擠⼀般型消費性記憶體產品供應，在國內廠商積極提高產出與擴充產
能下，未來將同步拉升封測代工需求。此外，模組產品代工市場方面，因顆粒價格上漲，使得終端消費性電子需
求放緩；僅伺服器與工控記憶體模組的訂單需求穩定。目前四座工廠 （⼀廠、⼆廠、3A、3B） 稼動率達 90%以上，
主要產品以 DDR4 為主、DDR3 為輔，並持續淘汰低附加價值產品、將增加 DDR4 相關設備並進行廠內擴充；新
五廠，則預計明年初量產貢獻營收。另傳統銲線封裝 Wire bond 產能持續擴充外，先進封裝製程設備於 3Q26 裝
機，4Q26 完成機台與產品驗證，預計今年小量生產。 
在製程技術方面，矽穿孔技術(3D TSV)與露銅製程(BVR)已裝機完成，4Q26 進入產品驗證，並完成送樣給客戶。
另覆晶封裝四層晶片堆疊方面，正做量產準備與送樣，預計 2Q27 進行驗證，開發產品應用於 DDR5 RDIMM 模
組產品。此外，為因應未來 DDR5 至 DDR 6 步入 Flip Chip 技術，公司提早佈局晶圓凸塊(Bump)與重佈線(RDL)
其製程產線(⼆廠無塵室)於第三季開始裝機與製程驗證，將拓展多樣化產品代工，開發晶片凸塊與高腳數封裝體之
特殊應用 ASIC， 由現有記憶體產品延伸至覆晶邏輯封裝代工領域。 
短期受惠記憶體供需緊張，中⻑期取決五廠產能開出與先進封裝進度：五廠已完成廠房建置，其中，⼆樓預計於
今年下半年完成裝機、驗證並於明年初開始量產，四、六、七樓則預計 2H27 陸續貢獻，故並非⼀次性全開出。
隨著代工價格陸續反映原料成本，且五廠高階產能將於明年初正式貢獻量產營收，若五廠全數開出後月營收有望
相較目前翻倍成⻑，但實際貢獻速度仍取決於客戶晶圓產能開出進度(產能開出預計明年中以後)。預估 2027 年營
收 173.5 億元，毛利率 20.54%，稅後 EPS 5.76 元，維持「增加持股」之投資評等，參考相關封測同業 PBR 介於
1~3 倍，目標價 70 元(2.3 倍 PBR*2027BVPS(F))。

2026 年營運平淡，未來關注新業務部門挹注 
 投資評價與建議 
研究部預估未來四季EPS為6.22元，預期本益比落在22倍，公司過往本益比區
間約落在15～30倍，考量到目前⾞用成⻑較為平穩，加上新業務仍需時間貢
獻，因此評價位於合理區間，靜待工業產品放量。 
 重點評論分析 
預期3Q26營運平穩 ：八月營收月減3.5%至6.4億元 ， 預期終端客戶拉貨動能因
⾞市疲弱而趨緩，獲利部分，銅價約有四成客戶未綁定銅價影響上半年毛利約
0.8~1ppts，且原物料並無下降趨勢，導致獲利要重回正常水準仍具挑戰性，
因此預估3Q26營收季增約1.5%達20.6億元，毛利率27.2%，稅後EPS 1.47元。 
產品線與車市相關性高，靜待新部門放量：展望未來，⾞用二極體業務與⾞市
相關性較高，而目前⾞市較為成熟，成⻑有限，傳統油⾞受到新能源⾞排擠，
因此預期傳統二極體占比預期將從 2025年的29%降至22%，高效能二極體則
從28%降至25% ， 產品轉向超高效能二極體 ， 且ULLD的單價為⼀般產品的6倍 ，
能帶動公司產品組合優化；48V MOSFET模組，因歐洲客戶拉貨及導入速度略
低於預期，動能來自於新工業部門產品包含了：(1)IGBT：切入數位相機市場，
公司表示 ， 4Q26會開始放量150K/月 ， 2027年預計可提升至800k顆/季 ； (2)SiC
模組：包含了650V/1200V/1700V模組，預計在2027年量產，基於以上，預期
2026年營運較為平淡 ， 2027年新部門放量改善產品組合 ， 帶動公司營運向上 。  
 投資風險 
原物料波動劇烈、新業務部門進度不如預期。

全球汽車市場雖受關稅影響但仍穩定成⻑：根據 Toward Automotive 預估全球汽⾞市場規模將從 2025 年的 4.5
兆美元提升至 2034 年的 7.5 兆美元，年複合成⻑率約 5.7%，而銷售地區推估北美地區占約 46%，其次為亞洲與
歐洲地區分別占約 33%及 14%，且 OICA 統計，2024 年全球汽⾞銷量年增 2.7%達約 9,531 萬輛，其中乘用⾞占
比最大共銷售 6,754 萬輛占 70.9%，商用⾞則銷售 2,777 萬輛占 29.1%，而依照 S&P Global 數據，2025 年輕
型⾞(總⾞輛重量額定值在約 4,536 公斤或以下的⾞輛)約為 9,170 萬輛，高於 2024 年的 8,820 萬輛，顯示全球
汽⾞市場雖受到新冠疫情、供應鏈中斷及關稅政策影響，但仍保持穩健的復甦。

受惠於減少碳排放趨勢，推動電動車市場成⻑：對於減少碳排放，多個國家的政府鼓勵使用電動⾞，成為推動電
動⾞成⻑的主要因素，根據 BloombergNEF 統計，電動⾞銷量從 2021 年的 647 萬輛成⻑到 2025 年約 2,056 萬
輛 ， 占乘用⾞的銷量已來到 26.5% ， 也顯示消費者已漸漸轉向購買電動⾞ ， 不過隨著規模擴大成⻑率也逐漸收斂 ，
且可觀察各國電動⾞占比也能發現，電動⾞在不同國家的接受度呈現分層態勢，其中荷蘭的滲透率在 12 月已達
75%，展現出強勁的轉型力道；中國則憑藉穩定的市場競爭力，全年維持在 50%至 60%的高位區間；相較之下，
美國的電動化進程最為緩慢，占比低於 15%，12M25 更落在約 8%的低點。

| 公司簡介  
朋程(8255)為車用二極體研發與製造大廠，市占約50%以上：朋程於1998年成立，公司專注於⾞用二極體的研發
與製造，根據公司年報，全球⾞用整流二極體市佔率約50%以上，產品包含標準型二極體(LLD)、高效能二極體及
超高效能二極體(ULLD)，主要應用在燃油⾞的發電機，將引擎產生出來交流電轉換為直流電後，儲存於電瓶，因
⾞輛結構不同，運用6~12顆/⾞，而在新能源⾞上，公司則提供SiC和GaN模組切入市場，客戶包含了各地區的汽
⾞零件Tier 1廠商 ， 而近期因環保法規積極推動減碳 ， 因此二極體規格逐漸轉為ULLD ， 使產品占比逐漸偏向ULLD ，
預估2026年ULLD占比約36%，LLD、傳統⾞用二極體及xEV分別為25%、22%及17%。 
圖表、歷年產品比重 圖表、產品類別比重

資料來源：朋程 
| 營運概況  
2Q26 因產能利用率提高帶動獲利回穩，3Q26 有望進入旺季而維持營運狀況：朋程 2Q26 營收季減 0.3%至 20.3
億元，受到海外客戶疲弱以及電動⾞相關產品於歐洲導入較慢影響，毛利率達 26.98%，與上季持平，主要因銅價
(約有四成客戶未綁定銅價影響約 0.8~1ppts)，稅後淨利率 6.24%，EPS 1.44 元，展望 3Q26，八月自結營收月減
3.5%至 6.4 億元，預期終端客戶拉貨動能因⾞市疲弱而趨緩，且原物料波動並未有下降趨勢，導致獲利要重回正
常水準仍具挑戰性，因此預估 3Q26 營收季增約 1.5%達 20.6 億元，毛利率 27.2%，稅後 EPS 1.47 元。 
展望未來，公司二極體主要應用在燃油發電機，市占穩定在 50%~55%，較容易受到⾞市銷量波動，而目前⾞市
較為成熟，全球輕型汽⾞銷售多落在 8,500 至 9,500 萬輛之間，成⻑有限，傳統油⾞受到新能源排擠以及因應環
保法規二極體將往更高效率產品做導入，使傳統二極體占比預期將從 2025 年的 29%降至 22%，且出貨量落在約
1.3 億~1.4 億顆(YoY-9%) ； 高效能二極體(LLD)則從 28%降至 25% ， 出貨量預期落在 7,200 萬至 7,500 萬顆(YoY-
9%)，產品轉向超高效能二極體(ULLD)，目前訂單及產能利用率皆滿載，需求較爲強勁，預計出貨量落在 4,000 萬
~4,200 萬顆(YoY+20%)，且公司表示 ULLD 的單價為⼀般產品的 6 倍，預期能帶動公司產品組合優化，占比從
21%提升至 36%，2027 年研究部預期趨勢仍往超高效能二極體做導入銷量有望年增 20%，傳統及高效能則呈現
年減；而用於混合能源⾞的 48V MOSFET 模組，2025 年新增的第三條產線目前已完成建置與驗證，年產能可提
升至 450 萬套，但歐洲客戶拉貨及導入速度略低於預期，產能利用率較低，而公司近期策略性佈局自研晶片，因
晶圓代工成本飆漲，經濟效益較差，且⾞用合約較⻑，轉嫁的難度較高，因此將延後推進，使 48V MOSFET 模組
毛利成⻑有限，基於以上既有產品線展望，預期 2026 年營運較為平淡，2027 年將隨⾞市回溫以及混合電動⾞的
滲透率提高，帶動公司營運向上。

柏文健康事業成立於 2005 年，資本額 8.04 億元， 2016 年掛牌上
櫃，並於 2019 年轉上市。柏文主要經營會員制連鎖運動健身中心
與休閒運動場館，柏文為國內第二大連鎖健身中心，僅次於世界
健身（ World GYM ）。有別於其他同業，柏文遵循定型化契約預
收使用費 50% 信託收費標準化 、 透明化 ， 以減少與客戶消費糾紛，
柏文會員主要以月繳型會員為主 ， 其中月繳制會員高達 85~90% 、
其餘 10~15% 為預繳制會員。採用進口頂級器材、引進創新課程，
以提高月繳型會員續約率，柏文會員續約率高達 70~75% ，優於
歐美地區的 30~35% 水準。

三. 旗下品牌與全台據點概況  
柏文旗下品牌主要有健身工廠、兒童體適能俱樂部、肖跳、滾吧、
人體工房與鐳射戰場等六個事業體，其中主要以健身工廠為營運
主體，若以會費等級區分，主要分旗艦店、中型店與小型店。旗
艦店月費 1688 元(一般金卡會員 )；小型店月費 1088 元(一般金卡
會員 )；中型店月費 1288 元(一般金卡會員 )。

四. 2026 年營運概況及展望

柏文營收主要分健身及娛樂服務、運動保建服務、入會費收入、
其他等四部分。

預估 2026 年健身及娛樂服務營收金額 44.55 億元， YoY+19.8%

健身及娛樂服務，主要為每月會員繳交月費部分。健身及娛樂服
務 2025 年營收金額 37.18 億元， YoY+20.17% 。健身及娛樂服務
2025 年營收成長動能包括： 1，在會員續約率由 2024 年的 62%
提升至 2025 年目標 65% ，加上 2025 年新增 8~9 家據點，柏文
2025 年底會員人數將來到 35~36 萬人，增幅達 16~20% 。2，柏
文己在 2024 年調整會籍使用費 ，2Q25~3Q25 調整效益開始顯現 。

健身及娛樂服務 01~08/2026 營收金額 28.80 億元 ，YoY+21.06% 。 
預期 2026 年，在會籍使用費效益持續顯現，加上新增據點數持續
增加，推估 2026 年底會員人數有機會來到 42~43 萬人，增幅
15.4~18.1% ，宏遠預估健身及娛樂服務 2026 年營收金額 44.55
億元， YoY+19.8% 。

運動保健服務，主要為會員再付費的教練課程，柏文會員人數中
約當 18~20% 會員會購買教練課程。

運動保健服務 2025 年年營收金額 21.4 億元， YoY+14.84% 。運
動保健服務 2025 年營運成長動能包括： 1，柏文 2024 年己開始
調整教練課程售價， 2025 年開始顯現。 2，柏文推出一對二與二
對三等，小型團體教練課程，將有助提升教練課程在會員滲透率

群。4，在運動按摩業務方面，柏文旗下己有少部分門市推出，小
幅貢獻 2025 年營收。

### Page 1

iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max Wait-Time Lukewarm

Maintained  Hold  
 Target price $369

iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max wait -time lukewarm: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max pre -
orders began on Sept 12 in the U.S. and many other countries. Generally speaking, the wati-
time appears lukewarm, with: 1) 3–4 weeks for 256GB/512GB Pro Max across all colors, as 
well as Burgundy 1TB in the U.S.；2) 2–3 weeks for Glacier 256GB/512GB Pro Max in China; 
3) 1–2 weeks for Black/Glacier 1TB Pro Max in the U.S. ；4) immediate availability for Silver 
1TB and most 2TB Pro Max models in the U.S, as well as most iPhone 18 Pro configurations 
except for Burgundy 256GB in the U.S . We attribute the lukewarm wait -time to limited spec 
upgrade, higher pricing (especially for large storage models), etc. We also expect the Pro Max 
to be impacted by iPhone Duo and the criticism of heavy weight.  
iPhone Duo feedback generally positive, yet we lower the  build plan: The iPhone Duo, 
priced at $1,999 in the U.S., opened pre ‑orders on Oct 16 and officially launched on Oct 23. 
Early reviews were positive, highlighting its polished folding experience, high ‑quality inner 
display, and improved multitasking in iO S 27, but also point to trade ‑offs including a heavier 
and thicker form factor, a visible crease, and a dual‑camera. Due to hinge constraints, we are 
reducing the iPhone Duo EMS build plan from 7m to 6m units in 2026. We also lower the 
iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Ma x build plan to 72m units given the constraints associated with the 
adjustable‑aperture camera. 
Maintain Hold: Driven by investors’ appetite being away from AI capex themes, Apple share 
price outperformed Nasdaq by 12% since July. Fundamentally, market’s worry about memory 
cost is being eased but should persist, in our view. We estimate the DRAM/NAND cost to be 
up from $0.37 per Gb/$0.09 per GB in iPhone 17 (initial launch) to $1.5 per Gb/$0.25 per GB 
in iPhone 18 Pro, suggesting likely cost pressure on current pricing. Valuation wise, the share 
price trades at 32x FY27E P/E with 20% earnings CAGR, suggesting the stock isn ’t cheap. 
We maintain earnings estimates and TP of $369, based on 35x FY27E.  
Risks: 1) weak demand, 2) competition, 3) product delays, 4) geo-tension.

Company Report | Apple 
4

Valuation and Recommendation  
Hold with TP of $369 
We rate Apple (AAPL US) Hold and set our TP at $369 which is based on 35x our FY27E EPS estimate. 
We believe it is important to capture the 2H26 -3Q27’s iPhone 18 product cycle, given high market 
interest. We adopt P/E methodology as we believe the market now mainly focuses on the company’s 
earnings outlook, and we usually apply P/E method to downstream firms.  
We believe Apple’s ecosystem will remain strong and associated revenue durability is high. This is 
backed by Apple's installed base growth, double digit YoY growth in services. However, the market 
would wait for visibility for its Apple Intelligence. Meanwhile, the market will need more visibility on the 
higher-high retail prices for the iPhone 18 series due to the rising cost over tariff and 2nm/memories. 
That said, we expect its earnings growth to be high-teens to 20% YoY in FY26E-FY28E, from single 
digit YoY in FY22-FY24. Considering >30x one-year P/E, the stock doesn’t look particularly cheap.

### Page 1

ab 18 September 2026
Global Research
UBS Global I/O Silicon Wafers
Silicon wafers: Meaningful price hikes necessary
for sufficient wafer supply in 2 years
Tighter supply/demand outlook in 2027 and beyond
Our industry analysis suggests the silicon wafer supply vs demand outlook will continue
to improve for the next 2 years, across all wafer sizes. We believe the 12”/ 8" wafer
demand is tracking to grow 11% / 11% in 2026, above our prior estimate of 9% / 8%

growth respectively, reflecting more robust customer restocking with healthier
inventory. Our updated industry model forecasts 12" wafer utilization to rise to
84%/91%/99% in 2026/27/28, vs 82%/88%/94% previously. We forecast 12" wafer
demand to grow 14%/13% in 2027/28 mostly through stronger restocking demand,
and faster DRAM capacity expansion especially into 2028E. 8" wafer utilisation should
also rise to 80%/90%/97% in 2026/27/28 vs prior estimates of 79%/87%/94%.

New industry expansion requires 40-50% price hike or more
We are optimistic about the price hike of silicon wafers and forecast this up-cycle to
possibly hike 20%+ a year in 2027-28, as the up-cycle in 2017-18. Our key argument is
that the large customers need to incentivize the wafer makers with higher prices in
considering new expansion in 2028 and beyond, otherwise there could be a severe
wafer shortage which could cap the industry growth. Major wafer makers are cautious

about expansion due to the the downturn after COVID in 2023-25 with only 12.3% op
margin and 6.8% ROE vs 18.3% / 19.1% in 2017-2022. Our industry feedback suggests
the wafer makers may need to see a 40-50% price hike or more to consider new
expansion from here.
Manageable China competition
Chinese wafer makers have been expanding aggressively, but we see a limited impact on
global supply vs demand in 2027-28. We believe the Chinese opportunity may mostly be

limited to the new mature logic fabs in China, while the local leading-edge logic /
memory clients are likely to prefer overseas wafers due to yield consideration. For non-
Chinese clients, it is hard to use Chinese wafers in meaningful volume given the re-
qualification required for mature logic foundry, and lagging performance for advanced
logic / memory. NSIG, the largest Chinese wafer maker, reported 12" ASP at US$54 vs
industry price of US$100-120, reflecting that most of its volume is still from non-

production wafers, in our view.
Stock ratings
The wafer stock P/B has corrected from 3.3x in July 2026 to 2.6x currently, around the
mid-point of the 1.0-4.0x cycle in the last 10 years, due to the market concern about
overall AI demand sustainability and the risk to the wafer recovery. We believe the
pullback presents compelling value for the structural up-cycle ahead. We have Buy
ratings on ShinEtsu, GlobalWafers, and Siltronic. We lower GlobalWafers's EPS
